description: This file defines the entity class 'LoanProductBorrowerCycleVariations' which models borrower cycle variations associated with a loan product in the Fineract system. It includes fields for various configuration parameters, constructors, equals/hashCode methods, and accessor methods. The class is annotated for JPA persistence and references other domain types like LoanProduct, LoanProductParamType, and LoanProductValueConditionType.
